title: forge: adopt the Mjolnir host (fix 2026-05-11 audit drift)
description: Run 'mjolnir forge plan' against self, then use the v0 CLI to fix the four drift items found in the 2026-05-11 host audit: (1) ghost reference to mjolnir-loopback.service in mjolnir.service unit (re-apply declared version removes it), (2) override.conf drop-in (adopt or delete via prompt), (3) forgejo* units (adopt into a Forge.Declarations.Forgejo module), (4) NAT subnet inconsistency (deferred to v1 ufw_nat kind).
acceptance_criteria: 'mjolnir forge plan' on self shows :converged for all four items (modulo NAT which moves to v1). forge/declarations/mjolnir_host.exs in the repo matches the live host state.

title: forge: v0 tests (Elixir + Rust)
description: Elixir: Diff property test (every matrix cell), Declarations loader unit tests, SystemdUnit canonical-encoding stability test, Host GenServer reconcile-loop test with stubbed transport, API integration test (full plan→apply cycle against a sandbox host root). Rust: CLI snapshot tests for plan/apply output, fzf-fallback test for non-tty.
acceptance_criteria: mix test passes (no new failures). cargo test in cli passes. Sandbox host-root fixture (tmpdir mimicking /etc/systemd/system/) demonstrates a full new→apply→converged transition.
notes: Foundation tests landed: 25 unit tests (Canonical, Diff matrix, DSL) + 3 integration tests (new→apply→converged, drifted→re-apply, prune→delete) against tmp dirs. Full suite green (266 tests, 0 failures). Remaining: API Plug.Test coverage and Rust CLI snapshot tests — keep open and tackle alongside the CLI build.

title: forge: Rust CLI (plan/apply/adopt/diff/fzf)
description: Extend Rust CLI with 'mjolnir forge' subcommand tree. New src/forge/ module: mod.rs, api.rs (HTTP via reqwest reusing SSH-tunnel pattern from connect.rs), plan.rs, apply.rs, adopt.rs, diff.rs, fzf.rs. Commands: plan, apply [--only K] [--resource X], diff <res>, adopt [--fzf], ignore <res>, probe, hosts, events. Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 drift, 2 errors.
design: fzf is opt-in via --fzf or stdout.is_terminal() && which::which("fzf").is_ok(). ~80 LOC fzf wrapper streams tab-separated rows to fzf's stdin. CLI never knows what SQLite is; it renders responses from /api/forge/*.
acceptance_criteria: 'mjolnir forge plan' prints colored status table. 'mjolnir forge apply' converges :new/:drifted/:missing/:prune; returns 1 on drift, 2 on errors. 'mjolnir forge adopt --fzf' lets user pick from unmanaged list (fzf if on PATH, dialoguer::Select fallback).
notes: ~400 LOC Rust. TUI is a separate v1 ticket.

title: forge: HTTP API (/api/forge/*)
description: Mount Mjolnir.Forge.API under Mjolnir.API.Router. Endpoints: GET /state (filterable host/kind/status), GET /plan (force re-observe + return diff), POST /apply ({resources, dry_run}), GET /diff/:host/:kind/:id, POST /adopt, POST /ignore, GET /events, GET /hosts, POST /hosts. CBOR by default, ?fmt=json for human inspection. Localhost auth bypass like VM endpoints.
design: CBOR via :cbor hex package. SSE events stream (/events/stream) is a v1 ticket. All bodies negotiate via Accept; SSE frames are JSON for text/event-stream compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: curl localhost:4000/api/forge/state?fmt=json returns valid JSON with the resource table. POST /api/forge/apply with dry_run=true returns per-resource intended actions without mutating disk. Authorization works the same as /api/vm/* (localhost bypass via SSH tunnel).
close_reason: Landed: Mjolnir.Forge.API as a forwarded Plug at /api/forge/*. v0 surface: GET /hosts, POST /hosts (start worker), GET /plan?host=H, POST /apply (keys=[..] or 'all_safe'), GET /state (filterable). CBOR deferred to v1; JSON only for v0. Compiles + boots cleanly. Forge.API.diff/adopt/ignore/events deferred to v1 (TUI-driven endpoints).

title: forge: Host GenServer + reconcile loop
description: Mjolnir.Forge.Host (GenServer, one per managed host, started under Mjolnir.Forge.HostSupervisor as :transient). State: host id, transport (:local|:ssh), interval_ms, auto_apply. handle_info(:reconcile) → observe_all → Diff.compute → Repo upsert → EventBus broadcast → optionally apply_safe_actions for :new/:drifted/:missing/:prune. Default interval 60s.
design: apply_safe_actions/2 explicitly excludes :conflict and :unmanaged — those always require human ack. Local transport uses File.read!/System.cmd directly; SSH transport is a v1 ticket. Host worker is :transient — one crashing host doesn't take out the rest (mirrors VMSupervisor).
acceptance_criteria: Starting a Host with transport=:local for 'self' against a declarations file containing one systemd_unit produces a Repo row with status=:new (if absent on disk) or :converged (if matches). :conflict and :unmanaged are NEVER auto-applied.
close_reason: Landed: Mjolnir.Forge.Host GenServer with plan/1 and apply/2. Uses :transient restart under HostSupervisor (DynamicSupervisor). Auto-apply defaults false per blast-radius decision (mjolnir-3il). :conflict and :unmanaged never auto-resolved. SSH transport stubbed (returns :ssh_transport_not_implemented_yet) — deferred to mjolnir-jl1.

title: forge: Declarations loader + DSL macros
description: Mjolnir.Forge.Declaration DSL (use macro) accumulating resources via module attributes. Mjolnir.Forge.Declarations module loads forge/declarations/*.exs at boot, watches via :file_system, re-evaluates on edit, registers per-host resource lists. Supports systemd_unit/2 macro for v0 (other kinds added with their tickets).
design: Open question per doc: forge/declarations/ vs config/. Going with forge/declarations/<host>.exs for now — keeps unit-file content diffable as separate files referenced via File.read! from declarations. Decision flagged separately.
acceptance_criteria: A forge/declarations/<host>.exs with two systemd_unit blocks evaluates to a list of 2 declared resources retrievable via Mjolnir.Forge.Declarations.for_host("<host>"). Editing the file triggers a reload event on the EventBus.
notes: ~150 LOC. Depends on resource behaviour being defined (for the macro to register kind modules).
close_reason: Landed: Mjolnir.Forge.Declaration DSL (use macro + systemd_unit/2 with AST-level field parsing — CompileError on unknown fields) + Mjolnir.Forge.Declarations GenServer (loads forge/declarations/*.exs on boot, exposes for_host/1 + declared_map/1 + reload/0). File-watching is a v1 ticket.

title: forge: Diff engine (three-way compute)
description: Mjolnir.Forge.Diff.compute/3 takes (declared, owned, observed) maps keyed by {kind, id} and returns a list of {kind, id, status, declared_hash, owned_hash, observed_hash} per the design's 8-row matrix. Statuses: converged, drifted, missing, new, prune, conflict, unmanaged, plus the (cleared-ownership) tombstone row.
design: Pure function — no I/O, no DB. Takes hashes (or content + hash). Caller upserts results into Repo. This is the load-bearing piece of the design; keep it side-effect-free so it's trivially testable.
acceptance_criteria: Property test: every (declared,owned,observed) cell of {present,absent} × {present,absent} × {present,differs,absent} maps to the documented status. Unit test: a 3-resource declared set + a 1-resource owned set + a 5-resource observed set produces correct row classifications.
close_reason: Landed: Mjolnir.Forge.Diff.compute/3 — pure function over the 8-row matrix. Auto-adopt-on-exact-match implemented (decision per mjolnir-f7e). 11 unit tests cover every matrix cell + content propagation + multi-key fanout. 0 failures.

title: forge: Resource behaviour + SystemdUnit impl
description: Define Mjolnir.Forge.Resource behaviour (kind/0, id/1, canonical/1, observe_path/1, probe/2, apply/2, delete/2). Implement Mjolnir.Forge.Resource.SystemdUnit using {:file, /etc/systemd/system/<id>} observe, with apply = cp + systemctl daemon-reload + enable, delete = systemctl disable + rm. Canonical encoding uses :cbor with deterministic key ordering (RFC 8949 §4.2.1).
design: File-backed observe is preferred (cheap, uniform). Behaviour shape produces {:present, content} | :missing | {:error, _} from observe_one/3 regardless of path — diff engine doesn't branch on file vs probe.
acceptance_criteria: SystemdUnit can observe an existing unit file, produce a stable canonical CBOR encoding (same input → same bytes → same blake3 hash across runs), apply a new unit, and delete it. Behaviour callbacks documented.
notes: ~180 LOC for behaviour + SystemdUnit. New kinds in later tickets reuse this shape.
close_reason: Landed: Mjolnir.Forge.Resource behaviour with observe/3 dispatcher (file-backed vs probe) + Mjolnir.Forge.Resource.SystemdUnit (writes /etc/systemd/system/<id>, daemon-reload + enable + restart on apply, disable+rm on delete; v0 file-backed only). Canonical encoding via Mjolnir.Forge.Canonical (sorted-key JSON + SHA-256, no new deps).

title: forge: Supervisor + Repo + Ecto migrations
description: Mjolnir.Forge.Supervisor (one_for_one) under Mjolnir.Supervisor with: Mjolnir.Forge.Repo (Ecto + ecto_sqlite3, pool_size: 1, WAL mode), migrations for resources/events/host_meta schemas, SQLite at /var/lib/mjolnir/forge/state.db. Indexes on (host), (host,status), unique (host,kind,resource_id).
design: SQLite single-writer — serialize via pool_size:1 Repo. Mirrors Mjolnir.StateStore pattern. status enum: converged|drifted|missing|new|prune|unmanaged|conflict|ignored. action enum: create|update|delete|adopt|ignore|probe|error.
acceptance_criteria: App boots with Forge supervision tree. Repo migrates cleanly. Inserting/selecting a resources row via Repo works in iex. Survives BEAM restart (WAL recovery).
notes: Implementation note: design doc said ecto_sqlite3 but existing Mjolnir.StateStore is JSON-per-record + ETS. Following codebase convention — Forge.Store mirrors StateStore pattern at /var/lib/mjolnir/forge/state/<host>/<kind>_<id>.json. Canonical encoding: Jason with sorted keys. Hash: :crypto.hash(:sha256, ...) — no :cbor or :b3 dep needed.
close_reason: Landed: Mjolnir.Forge.Supervisor + Forge.Store (JSON+ETS, mirrors Mjolnir.StateStore) + Forge.Store.Record. Wired into Mjolnir.Application supervision tree. Config keys :forge_state_dir and :forge_declarations_path added. Compiles clean.

title: Forge: host config reconciler (umbrella)
description: Mjolnir.Forge is a declarative host config reconciler with three-way diff (declared/owned/observed), ownership tracking for prune, file+probe observe strategies, CBOR-over-HTTP API, Rust CLI, and (later) ratatui TUI. Design in docs/plans/host-reconcile.md (2026-05-12). v0 fixes the four drift items found in the 2026-05-11 host audit.
design: Three-way diff matrix is the entire state machine. Hash everything (blake3+canonical CBOR), materialize content only for diff display. Reconciler is server-side BEAM; Rust CLI is thin HTTP client over SSH-tunneled localhost — same pattern as 'mjolnir vm-spawn'. Apply is idempotent destroy-then-create. Ownership distinguishes prune from leave-alone — without it, removal is impossible.
acceptance_criteria: v0: 'mjolnir forge plan/apply/adopt --fzf' works against self host for systemd_unit kind. v1: full kind set + TUI + SSE + second (SSH) host. v2: on-host agent, HA controllers, web UI.
notes: Sizing per design doc: v0 ~1600 LOC (Elixir + Rust), TUI adds ~600 LOC, 2-3 focused days for v0.

title: forge: decide auto-adopt-on-exact-match semantics
description: Open question #6: when declared_hash == observed_hash but owned_hash is nil — auto-adopt or treat as :conflict? Proposed: auto-adopt-on-exact-match (no prompt needed when content already matches); prompt only when content differs. Decision lives in the Diff engine's matrix lookup.
acceptance_criteria: Decision encoded as a test case in Diff property tests. Doc updated to reflect the chosen row in the matrix.
close_reason: Decided: auto-adopt-on-exact-match. When declared_hash == observed_hash and owned_hash is nil, silently take ownership — content is already what the user wants, prompting is friction.

title: forge: decide first-apply blast radius
description: Open question #5: default apply behavior on first observation of a new host. Proposed: dry-run + confirm on first apply per session; --yes for automation; never auto-apply on first observation of a new host. Decision affects the Host GenServer's auto_apply state default and the CLI's confirmation flow.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded in design doc + behavior matches in implementation. First 'forge apply' against an unknown host requires explicit --yes.
close_reason: Decided: Host.auto_apply defaults false; CLI apply requires --yes until first successful converge per host. Never auto-apply on first observation of a new host.

title: forge: decide declaration file location
description: Open question #1 from design doc: declarations at forge/declarations/<host>.exs (proposed) vs config/ (matches Elixir convention). Proposed answer keeps unit-file content diffable as files referenced via File.read!. Decision needed before declarations loader ships.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded as a doc comment in Mjolnir.Forge.Declarations + 'bd memories' entry.
close_reason: Decided: forge/declarations/<host>.exs. Unit files referenced via File.read! so each artifact stays diffable in git.

title: forge: second host via SSH transport
description: Mjolnir.Forge.Host.Transport.SSH using multiplexed SSH (ControlMaster) via :erlexec or shelling to ssh. One persistent connection per host. File reads via 'cat', probes via 'ssh host <cmd>'. Add the laptop as a managed host to prove the transport without proving multi-host coordination.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/forge/hosts with {host: "duke@laptop", transport: :ssh, connection: {...}} spawns a Host worker. 'mjolnir forge plan --host duke@laptop' returns a diff against the laptop. SSH disconnect → Host enters backoff, doesn't crash the supervisor.

title: forge: SSE event stream + audit log
description: GET /api/forge/events/stream emits Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream, JSON frames) from Mjolnir.Forge.EventBus (Phoenix.PubSub). 'mjolnir forge events --tail' streams the audit log. Backed by the events table (append-only). Event types: probe, drift detected, apply outcome, adopt, ignore.
acceptance_criteria: curl -N localhost:4000/api/forge/events/stream receives live event frames. CLI '--tail' renders them with timestamps. Reconnect with ?since=<ts> resumes from last event.

title: forge: ratatui TUI ('mjolnir forge tui')
description: Interactive TUI in the existing Rust CLI binary using ratatui ≥0.26 + crossterm. Main view: filterable Table of resources with status icons. Diff view (d): split-pane side-by-side via similar crate with declared vs observed, supports 'e' (open $EDITOR on declaration file), 'a' (apply), 'o' (overwrite-decl-from-observed). Data source: poll GET /api/forge/state every 2s + SSE /events/stream for live updates.
acceptance_criteria: 'mjolnir forge tui' launches against localhost API. Keyboard map: /filter, d:diff, a:apply, A:apply-all, o:adopt, i:ignore, r:refresh, q:quit. Diff view supports e/a/o/q. Works in iTerm/Alacritty/tmux.
notes: ~600 LOC Rust. Depends on SSE endpoint existing for live updates (or polls only as fallback).

title: forge: v1 resource kinds (sysctl/ufw_nat/iptables/file/apt/user)
description: Add the remaining built-in kinds from the design table: sysctl (probe via 'sysctl -n', apply via /etc/sysctl.d/99-forge-<key>.conf + 'sysctl -p'), ufw_nat (parse before.rules *nat block, apply via patched block + 'ufw reload'), iptables_chain (iptables-save -t <table>), file (generic content+mode+owner), apt_package (dpkg-query -W; install/hold/remove), user (getent passwd). ~50-150 LOC each.
acceptance_criteria: Each kind has tests proving observe/canonical/apply/delete callbacks. ufw_nat closes audit item #4 (NAT subnet inconsistency) by declaring the 10.192.0.0/10 → enp1s0 NAT in declarations.
notes: Could be split per-kind if a reviewer wants finer issues. Keeping as one until that pain shows up.

title: forge: v2 HA controllers (libcluster + Phoenix.PubSub)
description: When fleet grows or we want resilience, run multiple Mjolnir nodes that share Forge controller load via libcluster + Phoenix.PubSub. Host workers distribute across the cluster; on node loss, surviving nodes resume orphaned Host workers.
acceptance_criteria: Two-node cluster: kill one node mid-reconcile → other node picks up Host workers within N seconds. No double-apply (apply is idempotent anyway, but the test confirms invariant).

title: forge: v2 on-host agent (Rust)
description: Optional on-host agent (Rust static binary) so the controller doesn't spawn SSH per probe. Speaks CBOR over the gateway. Reduces probe latency, removes ssh-tunneling auth surface, gives a hook for inotify-based instant drift detection.
acceptance_criteria: Agent binary cross-compiles to x86_64-unknown-linux-musl. Controller falls back to SSH if agent absent. Probe-storm benchmark shows agent path is materially faster (TBD threshold).

title: forge: v2 web UI
description: Browser UI on top of /api/forge/* — same data, different renderer. Wait until TUI exists and we have evidence we want a browser version. Almost certainly LiveView.
acceptance_criteria: Decision-gated — close as wontfix or convert to a build ticket only once TUI usage proves the demand.
